[Karian]
Why are you looking at me?
How was it? Have fun??
scripts.translation:
[卡里安]
你为什么看着我？
感觉如何？玩得开心吗？

scripts.text: While you are on a trip, you gain lots of stuff. Make yourself lighter.
scripts.translation: 旅行途中，你会获得很多物品。让自己轻装上阵吧。

scripts.text:
[Karian]
Ah~! Did you know that you still have skill points?
Handle that quickly.
scripts.translation:
[卡里安]
啊~！你知道吗，你还有技能点？
赶紧处理一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Karian]
Ah~! Your level looks lower than before.
How did you degrade?
scripts.translation:
[卡里安]
啊~！你的等级看起来比之前低了。
你是怎么退级的？

scripts.text:
[Karian]
Please unequip your riding pet and try again!
scripts.translation:
[卡里安]
请卸下你的坐骑宠物，然后再试一次！

scripts.text:
[Karian]
Huh?
scripts.translation:
[卡里安]
嗯？

scripts.text:
[Karian]
I'm sorry about the lie.
The song written on this paper...
scripts.translation:
[卡里安]
对不起，我撒谎了。
这张纸上写的歌...

scripts.text:
[Karian]
I really want to find my friend's article left behind.
I couldn't find it by myself.
scripts.translation:
[卡里安]
我真的很想找到我朋友留下的文章。
我自己找不到。

scripts.text:
[Karian]
I gave it to my friend but he kept it precious...
scripts.translation:
[卡里安]
我把它给了我的朋友，但他一直珍藏着...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Did you give it to him?
Wait a second!
Just who are you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你把它给他了？
等一下！
你究竟是谁？

scripts.text:
[Maestro Song]
Yes! I'm 'Maestro Song'!
Are you surprised!?
scripts.translation:
[乐师 宋]
是的！我是“乐师 宋”！
你感到惊讶吗！？

scripts.text:
[Maestro Song]
This is my present to you.
scripts.translation:
[乐师 宋]
这是送给你的礼物。

scripts.text:
[Maestro Song]
You are also my friend.
scripts.translation:
[乐师 宋]
你也是我的朋友。

scripts.text: Talk.
scripts.translation: 交谈

scripts.text: Leave.
scripts.translation: 离开

scripts.text:
[Maestro Song]
The name 'Karian'?
He gave it to me.
scripts.translation:
[乐师 宋]
“卡里安”这个名字？
是他给我的。

scripts.text:
[Maestro Song]
He said that when he hears my song, he feels warmhearted.
'Kallianga' means hot air.
scripts.translation:
[乐师 宋]
他说听到我的歌，心里会感到温暖。
“Kallianga”的意思是热气。

scripts.text:
[Maestro Song]
He likes to sing...
scripts.translation:
[乐师 宋]
他喜欢唱歌...

scripts.text:
[Maestro Song]
And he's good at singing for sure?
scripts.translation:
[乐师 宋]
而且他唱歌一定很好听吧？

scripts.text:
[Maestro Song]
Ah! If it's okay with you, I want to take a pic with you in Juno?
scripts.translation:
[乐师 宋]
啊！如果你不介意的话，我想在朱诺和你拍张照？

scripts.text:
[Maestro Song]
I want to have something to remember you by.
scripts.translation:
[乐师 宋]
我想留个纪念，记住你。

scripts.text:
[Maestro Song]
See you.
It was really fun.
scripts.translation:
[乐师 宋]
再见。
真的很开心。

scripts.text:
[Karian]
How did you get in here?
scripts.translation:
[卡里安]
你是怎么进来的？
